title: Use Context to Boost Recall
description: To retrieve memories: - Recreate the setting: Recall the sights, sounds, and smells of the original context. - Use prompts: Bring objects or tools from the original environment to trigger memory. - Mentally revisit: Imagine yourself back in the original situation. Example: To recall work-related ideas, sit at your desk or review materials from the office.
